page.layout: One page of text in a single column, with the printed page number at the top left and a running head at the top right. No printed notes in the margins; the handwritten annotation in the left margin is not transcribed.

main_text.p: portere.Res in iudicio est.Intentio matris: hic filius mihi pro praemio debetur. D.non debetur. Q. An debeatur. R. Quia lex eum iubet interfici. F.At haec lex ab altera modificatur: quasi exceptio adiecta fit,nisi aliquem eorum percussor pro praemio poposcerit.D.An, cum duae leges contrariè scriptae reperiuntur,altera, si fieri possit, per alterā modificanda fit.Exemplum eiusdem generis extat etiam apud Paulū in L. Nesennius, 34.D.de negot.gest. Auia nepotis sui negocia gerens,cum alimenta ei decerni non postulasset,eum tamen aluit: In

page.notes: The running head is a dark, blurred block and could not be read. The handwritten marginal note in the left margin is not printed text and is left out. The catchword "ra-" is the start of the next word on the following page. Long s has been written as plain s throughout. Printed "eft", "fi", "nifi" and "po-ftulaffet" were normalised to est, si, nisi and postulasset; this is a spelling change, not a reading uncertainty.
